title: Button Cut 200
description: Snip gleaming tailor shears along crisp straight lines of matching buttons across 200 tactile ASMR craft puzzles until the cloth is spotless.
controls: Swipe cleanly across two or more aligned buttons of the same color to snip them off the fabric board.

zh-CN.title: 剪扣子 200 关
zh-CN.description: 超治愈 ASMR 剪纽扣益智闯关：沿着直线一剪刀剪落成排同色纽扣，200 道巧思关卡一剪清空极度解压！
zh-CN.controls: 按住沿横、竖或斜线滑过两个及以上同色纽扣，松手一刀剪下清空布面全部纽扣。
